title: Alberta Health Care Insurance Plan (AHCIP)
description: Register for the Alberta Health Care Insurance Plan to receive coverage for insured hospital and physician services. New and returning residents must apply to be eligible for publicly funded health care.

title: Driver's Licence
description: Apply for, renew, or replace an Alberta driver's licence. Learn about graduated licensing, road tests, and the documents you need to bring to a registry agent.
ministry: Service Alberta and Red Tape Reduction

title: Vehicle Registration
description: Register a car, truck, trailer, or motorcycle in Alberta and renew your vehicle registration before it expires. Available in person at any registry agent or online.
ministry: Service Alberta and Red Tape Reduction

title: Child Care Subsidy
description: Financial support to help eligible families with the cost of licensed child care. Subsidy amounts depend on household income, the age of the child, and the type of care.

title: Assured Income for the Severely Handicapped (AISH)
description: AISH provides financial and health benefits to eligible Albertans with a permanent medical condition that substantially limits their ability to earn a living.

title: Income Support
description: Income Support helps Albertans who do not have enough money to cover basic needs like food, clothing, and shelter. Emergency and ongoing support is available.

title: Alberta Seniors Benefit
description: A monthly income supplement for eligible low-income seniors aged 65 and older who already receive the federal Old Age Security pension.

title: Student Aid (Loans and Grants)
description: Apply for student loans, grants, scholarships, and awards to help pay for full-time or part-time post-secondary studies in Alberta.

title: Birth Certificate
description: Order an Alberta birth certificate for yourself or your child. Certificates are proof of a birth registered in the province and can be ordered online or at a registry agent.
ministry: Service Alberta and Red Tape Reduction

title: Marriage Licence
description: Get a marriage licence before your wedding ceremony in Alberta. Both partners must attend a registry agent together with valid identification.
ministry: Service Alberta and Red Tape Reduction

title: Register a Business
description: Register a sole proprietorship, partnership, or corporation in Alberta, reserve a business name, and file the records you need to operate legally.
ministry: Service Alberta and Red Tape Reduction

title: Small Business Resources
description: Guides, funding programs, and advisory services to help Alberta entrepreneurs start, grow, and finance a small business.

title: Employment and Training Supports
description: Find job search help, training programs, and career planning services to help Albertans get back to work or change careers.

title: Apprenticeship and Industry Training
description: Start an apprenticeship in a skilled trade, find an employer sponsor, and work toward journeyperson certification in Alberta.

title: Find a Family Doctor
description: Use the Alberta Find a Doctor directory to search for family physicians and clinics accepting new patients near you.

title: Mental Health Help Line
description: Confidential 24/7 phone support for Albertans experiencing mental health concerns, crisis, or distress, with referrals to community services.

title: Immunization and Vaccines
description: Book immunization appointments, view the routine vaccination schedule, and learn which free vaccines are available to Albertans of all ages.

title: Education Property Tax
description: Learn how the provincial education property tax is calculated, how it appears on your municipal tax bill, and what assistance programs exist.

title: Land Titles and Property Records
description: Search land titles, register property transfers, and request copies of title documents and survey plans held by Alberta Land Titles.
ministry: Service Alberta and Red Tape Reduction

title: Residential Tenancy and Rental Disputes
description: Understand your rights and responsibilities as a landlord or tenant, and resolve disputes about deposits, repairs, or eviction through the Residential Tenancy Dispute Resolution Service.
ministry: Service Alberta and Red Tape Reduction

title: Affordable Housing
description: Apply for subsidized and affordable rental housing for lower-income Albertans, seniors, and families through local housing management bodies.

title: Provincial Park Camping Reservations
description: Reserve campsites, comfort camping, and group areas in Alberta's provincial parks and recreation areas through the online reservation system.

title: Hunting and Fishing Licences
description: Buy hunting and sportfishing licences, apply for special draws, and review regulations for seasons, limits, and wildlife management units.

title: Wildfire Status and Fire Bans
description: Check the current wildfire situation, fire advisories, restrictions, and bans across Alberta, and report a wildfire.

title: Pay a Traffic Ticket or Court Fine
description: Pay provincial violation tickets and court-ordered fines online, request a time to pay, or dispute a ticket in Alberta.

title: Police Information and Criminal Record Checks
description: Learn how to request a criminal record check or vulnerable sector check for employment, volunteering, or licensing purposes.

title: Maintenance Enforcement Program
description: The Maintenance Enforcement Program collects and distributes court-ordered child and spousal support payments between parties.

title: Personal Directives and Powers of Attorney
description: Create a personal directive or enduring power of attorney so someone you trust can make personal or financial decisions if you lose capacity.

title: Foster and Adoptive Parenting
description: Learn how to become a foster or adoptive parent in Alberta, the approval process, and the supports available to caregivers and children.

title: Prescription Drug Coverage
description: Government-sponsored drug plans that help Albertans pay for eligible prescription medications, including coverage for seniors and non-group members.

title: Continuing Care and Home Care
description: Access home care, supportive living, and long-term care services for seniors and Albertans with complex health needs.

title: Coverage for Seniors (Dental and Optical)
description: Supplementary health benefits for eligible Alberta seniors, including dental, optical, and other extended health coverage administered by Alberta Blue Cross.

title: Register for School
description: Find out how to enrol a child in kindergarten through Grade 12 in Alberta, including public, separate, francophone, and charter schools.

title: High School Transcripts and Diplomas
description: Order official Alberta high school transcripts and diploma exam results, or request a replacement diploma, through your myPass account.

title: Settlement Services for Newcomers
description: Connect newcomers to Alberta with settlement agencies that offer language training, employment help, and community orientation.

title: Alberta Advantage Immigration Program
description: A provincial nominee program that nominates eligible workers and entrepreneurs for permanent residence to support Alberta's economy.

title: Disability Parking Placard
description: Apply for a placard that allows a person with a disability to park in designated accessible parking spaces across Alberta.
ministry: Service Alberta and Red Tape Reduction

title: Farm Fuel Benefit
description: Eligible farmers can receive a provincial fuel tax exemption on marked gasoline and diesel used in farming operations.

title: Private Well Water Testing
description: Learn how to collect and submit samples to test the safety of private well water for bacteria and chemical contaminants in Alberta.
